Dead Sun

Player's guide: every trait, unit, item and augment. Tap any name to jump to it.

TraitsUnitsItemsAugmentsStatuses
Units cost 1 to 5 gold. Three copies merge into a 2-star, three 2-stars into a 3-star. A unit fills its mana by attacking and being hit, then casts its ability.
Traits switch on when you field enough different units that share one. Most units have an origin and a class.
Items: two components on the same unit combine into a completed item. A unit holds three.
Emblems are items that make the holder count as one more unit of a trait.
Augments are permanent bonuses you pick from three, a few times a game.
Dusk falls 10s into every fight: every unit gains 8 mana a second. The Eclipse comes at 20s: units attack 50% faster, gain 20 mana a second, deal 6% more damage for every second it lasts. Much of the set turns on these moments.

Unit cost: 12345   Ability numbers read 1-star / 2-star / 3-star. Health and Attack grow with stars; the other stats do not.

Origins Where a unit comes from.

Cult of the Black Sun

Emblem: Emblem of the Black Sun = Black Sun Shard+Grimoire

Cultists pay in blood: abilities cost 20 / 30 / 30% less mana and some health instead, but bleeding never takes them below 10 / 10 / 5% health. They deal 15 / 15 / 25% more damage. At 6 the whole board joins the Cult.

  • 2Casts cost 20% less mana and 3% health (never below 10%); +15% damage
  • 4Casts cost 30% less mana and 4% health (never below 10%); +15% damage
  • 6Every ally pays in blood: 30% less mana and 4% health per cast (never below 5%); +25% damage
AcolyteFlagellantRazor NunVoid PreacherDread BaronessEclipse Herald

Daybreak

The sun's last soldiers fight hardest while it is up. Daybreak units start in Daylight: 24 / 40 / 40% more damage, healing and shielding and 24 / 40 / 40 Armor and Magic Resist, until the Eclipse puts it out, and they open the fight by shielding the allies beside them. At 6 the whole board stands in the light, and the Eclipse does not take it until a moment later.

  • 2Daylight until the Eclipse: +24% damage, healing and shielding, +24 Armor and Magic Resist; shield the allies beside you for 10% of their health
  • 4Daylight until the Eclipse: +40% damage, healing and shielding, +40 Armor and Magic Resist; shield the allies beside you for 15% of their health
  • 6Every ally: Daylight, +40% damage, healing and shielding, +40 Armor and Magic Resist, lasting 4 seconds into the Eclipse; shield the allies beside you for 15% of their health
Dawn WardenHospitallerZealot ArcherLamplighterPenitent BruteSun Cantor

Infernal

Emblem: Infernal Emblem = Black Sun Shard+Gut Chain

Infernals deal more damage and their attacks burn, stacking to 3. At 4 their casts detonate the burn on the target for 0 / 8 / 12% of its max health per stack and half of burns leap to a neighbour. Their attacks also blight (40% less healing) from 4. At 6 every ally burns, blights and detonates, and the Eclipse sets every enemy alight.

  • 2+8% damage; attacks burn, stacking to 3
  • 4+12% damage; attacks blight (40% less healing); casts detonate the target's burn for 8% max health per stack; half of burns leap to a neighbour
  • 6Every ally: +20% damage, attacks burn and blight (40% less healing), casts detonate burn for 12% max health per stack; the Eclipse sets every enemy alight
ImpHellhoundAsh WitchBrimstone KnightPit LordMolten Tyrant

Chrome Legion

Emblem: Legion Emblem = Black Sun Shard+Chrome Plate

Legionnaires standing beside another Legionnaire gain 35 / 60 / 90 Armor and Magic Resist.   • 4+60 Armor and Magic Resist, 12% less damage and +8% Attack Speed beside another Legionnaire

Nightfang

Emblem: Nightfang Emblem = Black Sun Shard+Hair Trigger

At 12 / 9 / 6 seconds every Nightfang transforms: faster attacks, Lifesteal, healed 15 / 30 / 40% and cleansed of burns and other afflictions, their abilities take their beast form and their attacks make enemies bleed. Hold until the moon. At 4, each Nightfang's first kill calls a Wolf; at 6, one every 4 seconds, and the Blood Moon rises with the Eclipse: they vanish for a second and come back frenzied with 40% more Attack.

Revenant

Emblem: Revenant Emblem = Black Sun Shard+Grave Shroud

A Revenant that dies rises again as 1 / 1 / 2 Skeleton for 9 seconds, and Skeletons burst when they fall, though each one an enemy kills is a kill for them. Revenants (not their Skeletons) gain 8 / 12 / 20% Attack and 8 / 12 / 20 Ability Power for every allied summon on the field. At 4 one Skeleton marches in with you; at 6 the Skeletons are stronger, two march in, enemies killed by Revenants rise as your Skeletons too, and the Eclipse raises three fallen allies at 60% health.

  • 2+100 Health; rise as a Skeleton on death; +8% Attack and +8 Ability Power per allied summon
  • 4+150 Health; start with a Skeleton and rise as one on death; +12% Attack and +12 Ability Power per allied summon
  • 6+250 Health; start with 2 strong Skeletons and rise as 2 on death; +20% Attack and +20 Ability Power per allied summon; enemies killed by Revenants rise as strong Skeletons; the Eclipse raises 3 fallen allies at 60% health
Bone ThrallGrave ArcherBonecallerWraithBone OracleLich Knight

Scavenger

Scavengers strip the fallen: they start every fight with 2 / 2 / 3 pickup and gain another whenever an ally dies or a Scavenger makes a kill, summoned units included. Each pickup is +10 / 15 / 15% Attack and +12 / 18 / 20 Ability Power for the fight. At 4 each pickup also heals 0 / 8 / 12% health. At 6 every ally scavenges, and the Eclipse hands them the whole field: 0 / 0 / 5 pickups at once.

  • 2Start with 2 pickups; +10% Attack and +12 Ability Power per pickup
  • 4Start with 2 pickups; +15% Attack and +18 Ability Power per pickup, each healing 8% health
  • 6Every ally scavenges: +15% Attack and +20 Ability Power per pickup, each healing 12%, 3 to start; the Eclipse grants 5 pickups at once

When the fight starts, each Jailer throws its chain straight down its column and holds the enemy furthest back in it for 1.5 seconds (the nearest column when its own is empty). Jailer attacks have a 40% chance to slow the target, and deal 60 / 70% of their Attack as bonus true damage to stunned, slowed, silenced or disarmed enemies.

Statuses

The conditions that abilities, items and traits put on units.

Ascendant

Gains 10% attack and attack speed every second.

Bleeding

Loses 1.5% max health per second per stack, up to 3 stacks.

Bulwark

Intercepts enemy projectiles aimed at adjacent allies.

Burning

Loses 2.5% max health per second per stack, up to 3 stacks.

Chained

Held in a Jailer's chains: cannot act, and gains no mana.

Chilled

Attack speed reduced by 10% per stack.

Consumed

Curse (uncleansable): loses 4% of max health every second.

Crumbling

Falls apart when this ends.

Daylight

The sun is still up: 8% more damage, healing and shielding and 8 Armor and Magic Resist per stack. It goes out when the Eclipse comes.

Disarmed

Cannot attack. Casting is unaffected.

First Light

10% more damage and healing until the Eclipse.

Frenzied

Attack speed increased by 30%.

Held by a chain from the grave: cannot move. If it dies held, it rises as a Skeleton for whoever chained it.

Damage aimed at adjacent allies hits this unit instead.

+15 Armor and Magic Resist per stack.

Haunted
